newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-DBS says accumulate Belle.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-DBS says accumulate Belle.

text.p: DBS Investment Research has recommended investors to accumulate shares of Philippine gaming and property firm Belle Corp.

"In our opinion, no other company in its peer group has both an attractive gaming return and the prospect of a rapidly growing property development profit stream," analyst Winnie Chiu said in a report made available to Reuters on Wednesday.
The company, which is developing luxury homes, is expected to register a 144 percent rise in profits each year over the next two years from the sale of its property projects, she said.
Gaming income is forecast to rise by 57 percent over the next three years.
Belle is opening a 15,000 square metre hotel casino and a racetrack. At present, it runs a network of on-line lottery betting stations through a subsidiary.
